object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. The move_object tool's successful moves are asserted only below the tool: the tool-level tests pass without any move (see weak), so a test through the tool is a gap.
object.description: Move a sub-object to the top level; move an object under a new top-level object; with top-level objects 0, 2 and 3, move 3 before 2, and in a fresh copy move 0 after 2. Expected: the first object is at the top level; the second is under the new parent object; the top level reads 0, 3, 2; and then 2, 0, 3.
